newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Jurong Engineering wins two contracts.
newsitem.headline: Jurong Engineering wins two contracts.

text.p: Singapore's Jurong Engineering Ltd said on Wednesday it had won the bidding for two contracts worth Singapore $38 million.
One is for supply, installation and construction at the Bedok sewerage treatment plant in Singapore, the company said in a statement.
Jurong will be joined in the project by Ishikawajima-Harima Heavy Industries and Mitsubishi Corp of Japan.
The other project is for mechanical and erection works at the Al-Weer Gas Turbine plant in Dubai, the United Arab Emirates.
The company also said it had raised its stake in Thai associate Thai-JEL to 55 percent through the acquisition of an additional 6.0 percent of its shares.
Thai-JEL has a paid-up capital of 10 million baht and is involved in the construction and engineering business.
